mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.color_name, s.size_name, s.barcode, IFNULL(t.qty, 0) AS qty, IFNULL(t.lock_qty, 0) AS lock_qty, IFNULL(t.recovery_qty, 0) AS recovery_qty, IFNULL(t.warn_qty, 0) AS warn_qty FROM product_sku s LEFT JOIN stock t ON s.id = t.sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} and s.is_delete = 0
